name: Zombie Repel
steps: Hit the zombie with the bowl of rice. Use the feather duster to smack him.
Tap the TV and use the nunchucks.
Strike him with the broken chair leg.
Tap the AC and use the fan blade.
Throw the kitchen faucet at him.
Hit him with the metal water pipe.
Take down the curtain rod and use it as a weapon.
Launch the high-heel shoe from the rod.
Finish by hitting him with the toilet plunger.
